question: Where’s the closest café lying along the route toward River Stone Resorts and Bear Paw Suites, Estes Park, CO from Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center, Denver, CO?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-104.990709 39.728464)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.562396 40.390357)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-104.990709 39.728464)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-104.990709 39.728464)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
